articles.title: Yemen Condemns Houthi Terrorist Attack on Financial Center's Tower in Riyadh
articles.description: ADEN-SABA The Republic of Yemen strongly condemned the terrorist attack by Iran-backed terrorist Houthi militias, which targeted one of the towers of the Financial Center in Riyadh, resulting in injuries to a number of civilians. This is a blatant violation of the sovereignty of sisterly Saudi Arabia and a clear breach of international law and international humanitarian law, the ministry asserted. In a statement issued today, Wednesday, the ministry confirmed the full solidarity of the Republic of Yemen with the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and its support for all measures it takes to protect its security, sovereignty, and stability.

articles.title: Pahalgam Rebuilds Its Tourism Economy After The 2025 Terrorist Attack | Jammu and Kashmir | News18
articles.description: Eighteen months after the devastating terror attack in Baisaran Valley, Pahalgam is witnessing a gradual revival in tourism, with visitors returning to its scenic landscapes, hotels and popular tourist destinations. The April 22, 2025 attack, which killed 26 people, including 25 tourists and a local pony operator, had dealt a severe blow to Kashmir's tourism industry, triggering cancellations and a sharp fall in visitor numbers. But signs of recovery are now emerging. Official figures cited in April 2026 indicated that nearly 10 lakh visitors had travelled to Pahalgam between April 2025 and April 2026. Tourism activity has picked up, with hotels, restaurants and local businesses hoping for a sustained return of visitors. n18oc_the-5PM-brief n18oc_india News18 Mobile App - https://onelink.to/desc-youtube
